== Build notes (25 October 2026) ==
* Photo: [[:File:Richard Handley DecipherCon 1999.jpg]] is cropped from Decipher's DecipherCon 1999 photo fri26 (Wayback). The caption names Handley with Evan Lorentz and Kim Burns; he is the man on the right, being briefed. Photographer not credited by Decipher.
* "All Decked Out" (''Star Wars Insider'' 48, pp. 78–79) is listed in the issue's contents as "Decipher This!" (p. 32). The photo credit on p. 79 reads "photos by Rich Handley".
* "Deal With It!" (''Star Wars Insider'' 52) runs pp. 68–69 (p. 70 is the letters page).
